metadata.description: Siliqun Rotor plugins for Claude Code: the decision engine, and agentbus for agent teams.

plugins.name: siliqun-rotor
plugins.description: Route a request to one of your declared tools, ask for a missing value, or refuse; and integrate Siliqun Rotor into an application.

plugins.name: agentbus
plugins.description: The live channel between your AI agents: messages, tasks and decisions over MCP, with unread messages shown at each prompt and each agent's status posted after every turn. Needs your team's own agentbus.
